news.title: SLU Expert on First Ladies Pens Essay for National Civic Education Project
news.summary_en: Diana B. Carlin, Ph.D., professor emerita of communication at Saint Louis University and an expert on First Ladies, penned an essay on Jane Pierce for In Pursuit, a national civic education project that creates lessons from the past for future generations.
